title.value: Trajectory balance: Improved credit assignment in GFlowNets
title.justification: The title is provided on the first page of the paper, indicating the main focus of the research.
title.quote: Trajectory balance: Improved credit assignment in GFlowNets

analysis.description: This paper focuses on improving Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) by introducing a new learning objective called trajectory balance. The authors propose trajectory balance as an efficient alternative to previously used objectives for better credit propagation across long action sequences. The paper proves that any global minimizer of the trajectory balance objective can define a policy that samples exactly from the target distribution. Through experiments, the authors demonstrate the benefits of trajectory balance for GFlowNet convergence, diversity of generated samples, and robustness to long action sequences and large action spaces.
